article.title: Agent cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation backed by FirstMark and a who’s who of angels
article.summary: Daytona is building a cloud for agents that's like giving every agent its own computer. It has attracted founders of Stripe, Perplextity, Datadog, Mercor, and others as angels, it says.
